title: Lesson 91: Three Men in a Basket

segments.text: Where was the station's Commanding Officer?
A pilot noticed a balloon which seemed to be making for a Royal Air Force station nearby.
segments.translation: 一名飞行员注意到一个气球似乎正向附近的皇家空军基地飞去。

segments.text: He informed the station at once, but no one there was able to explain the mystery.
segments.translation: 他立即通知了基地，但那里没有人能解释这个谜团。

segments.text: The officer in the control tower was very angry when he heard the news,
segments.translation: 控制塔里的军官听到这个消息时非常生气，

segments.text: because balloons can be a great danger to aircraft.
segments.translation: 因为气球对飞机来说是很大的危险。

segments.text: He said that someone might be spying on the station and the pilot was ordered to keep track of the strange object.
segments.translation: 他说可能有人在侦察基地，并命令飞行员跟踪这个奇怪的物体。

segments.text: The pilot managed to circle the balloon for some time.
segments.translation: 飞行员设法围着气球转了一段时间。

segments.text: He could make out three men in a basket under it and one of them was holding a pair of binoculars.
segments.translation: 他可以看出气球下面的吊篮里有三个人，其中一人拿着一副双筒望远镜。

segments.text: When the balloon was over the station, the pilot saw one of the men taking photographs.
segments.translation: 当气球飞到基地上空时，飞行员看到其中一人在拍照。

segments.text: Soon afterwards, the balloon began to descend and it landed near an airfield.
segments.translation: 不久后，气球开始下降，降落在一个机场附近。

segments.text: The police were called in, but they could not arrest anyone,
segments.translation: 警察被叫来了，但他们无法逮捕任何人，

segments.text: for the basket contained two Members of Parliament and the Commanding Officer of the station!
segments.translation: 因为吊篮里是两名议员和基地的指挥官！

segments.text: As the Commanding Officer explained later, one half of the station did not know what the other half was doing!
segments.translation: 正如指挥官后来解释的那样，基地的一半不知道另一半在做什么！
